raw_translation: Ndiyo, wakati congruences kukubaliana modulo yao kubwa ya kawaida divisheni. Kwa mfano, x ≡ ZXQPH0000QXZ (mod ZXQPH0001QXZ) na x ≡ ZXQPH0002QXZ (mod ZXQPH0003QXZ) pamoja na x ≡ ZXQPH0004QXZ (mod ZXQPH0005QXZ). Mifumo ya mgogoro ni taarifa kama kuwa na ufumbuzi.
source: Yes, when the congruences agree modulo their greatest common divisor. For example, x ≡ 2 (mod 4) and x ≡ 6 (mod 8) combine to x ≡ 6 (mod 8). Conflicting systems are reported as having no solution.
translation: Ndiyo, wakati congruences kukubaliana modulo yao kubwa ya kawaida divisheni. Kwa mfano, x ≡ 2 (mod 4) na x ≡ 6 (mod 8) pamoja na x ≡ 6 (mod 8). Mifumo ya mgogoro ni taarifa kama kuwa na ufumbuzi.

raw_translation: Matumizi ya lengo iliyotolewa na daktari wako wa mifugo na label halisi package. Food nishati, treats, virutubisho, ukuaji, ujauzito, ugonjwa na hali ya mwili inaweza kubadili mahitaji ya chakula; kushauriana na daktari wako wa mifugo kwa ajili ya mpango binafsi.
source: This tool does not calculate or recommend a pet’s calorie needs. Use a target provided by your veterinarian and the exact package label. Food energy, treats, supplements, growth, pregnancy, illness and body condition can change feeding needs; consult your veterinarian for an individual plan.
